first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports simplifying onboarding as a durable lever for early adoption. Verify the original onboarding and pricing records before committing because aggressive competitor pricing creates an acquisition risk, while discounting may trade off sustainable revenue quality.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. The verified onboarding result improved completion (+13%), reduced time-to-value (2.1 days), and increased 30-day retention (+3%), directly addressing both current declines with evidence of durable value. Promotional pricing is not selected: its verified retention decline makes its qualified-revenue lift unsustainable. Track meaningful activation, qualified conversion, and 30-day retention alongside completion before scaling.
